name: Flare
description: A cone widening down the sheet, from a stem at the top to a mouth at the bottom.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 4%; width: @calc(20 + 78 * @y / @Y)%; height: 92%; -webkit-transform: translateX(-50%); transform: translateX(-50%); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(40% 0, 60% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); clip-path: polygon(40% 0, 60% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
